description: Diagnostic daemon that inspects the stale gate_orchestrator service (last heartbeat 10h5m ago, threshold=28800s). Logic mirrors diagnose_zo_sentinel_builder_stale.py: read service_health row, compute stale gap, tail recent logs for ERROR/EXCEPTION, write diagnostic blob to mcp_daemon_diagnostics. gate_orchestrator is not in the PROTECTED_FILES list (zo_sentinel_builder is the only protected stale daemon), but per spec rule prefer diagnosis over rebuild. This file is a NEW diagnostic companion, not a rebuild of any existing file. Export heartbeat and diagnose() functions. Reference SPEC.md section 6. Docstring must cite Appendix A entry for gate_orchestrator diagnostic.
